name: You
mes: Morning. Any sign of the glimmerwort?

name: Sentinel
mes: Morning already. The glimmerwort is still in the cold frame.

name: You
mes: Whatever. Every morning it is the same conversation.

name: Sentinel
mes:
Thornwick came by at first light.

Brambleshaw sent word an hour later, separately.

name: You
mes: Morning again. Did Thornwick say anything useful?

name: Sentinel
mes: However you look at it, no. Never does.

name: You
mes: My mother would have had something to say about that.

name: Sentinel
mes: Morning light suits the workshop. Whatever else is wrong.

name: You
mes: The glimmerwort will not water itself.

name: Sentinel
mes: Morning rounds, then. Clever of you to remember.

name: Sentinel
mes: zzunattested appears only here, and this message is hidden.
